svg.text: BasicModel — the three grammars, their operators, their inverses, and what each face may touch

Draft for annotation · 2026-11-01 (current as built; decided-not-built marked >) · operators have no return values, only effects: a signature is roles × faces × read (R) / write (W) over the accessible mind
A. The accessible mind — ten subsystems (dashed = reducible or derived; every access is bounded)
the word stream, read by bracket
at once; two lanes per concept,
one point = a REGION of order 0;
move / extend them into one IDEA,
frozen per sentence; read by attention,
GAIN FIELD, residual in two lanes;
lanes, access, surprise); LTM1: rows of
two tagged refs; cued recency window
READ to know cutoff is near, CHARGED
by thought ops and the generate walk

field (parallel, graded) → CODE = nearest-row projection; words arrive as codes → operators compose an IDEA that must regenerate its codes + operations (generativity) · stores: perceptual, conceptual, LTM0 / LTM1 (MTM is not one of the ten) · predictions: priming, expectation · resource: budget · relation: taxonomy · cells = declared effects per face · > = decided and specified, not yet built
B. The three grammars (faces) and their contexts
reads: 1 perceptual knowing (word stream, row-owned), 2/3, 4, 5, 9; never 6, 7, 8, 10
writes: 4 (push / fold); 2/3 are permitted and declared only by part and ask
7.5 ONE operation per round: one softmax over every operator × every location, with
the field brackets and bind's locations + a zero-logit dummy; a binary fold shortens by one
STOP is eligible once the stack fits its slots; a fixed round budget, reduction pressure; no DP
two trials, greedy (argmax, item 8's tie rule) and one sampled departure; both train
the face never reads 6; the chooser takes expectation's detached prime as a logit bias
chooser credit: score function on the trials' detached R + A difference
gradient: live through the chosen operator's value; separateChooser=true detaches features
reads: every subsystem but 1; 7 only through bounded readers (query, ask, isTrue,
isPart, isEqual, infer, intuit, bind); 5: query, ask, intuit; 6: bind, gain; 10: isPart, infer
writes: 4 and 8 (every rule), 2/3 (part, ask; intuit writes 2), 6 (gain); none declares 7
only <thought> declarations authorize a boundary action; executors run at a completed row
chooser: the SAME selection layer as compose (thought_logits) — operation | conclude
gradient: none through effects; chooser features detached; credit by departure
intuit's sparse Sigma-over-Pi weights are output-owned; infer accepts a pair from evidence
cost: every choice / execute / descend / return charges 8 (attentionBudget units)
bracket candidates and bind's choice live in the compose softmax, not in this one
reads: the concluded idea in 4 (GIVEN, on-manifold), 2/3, 8, its OWN emitted prefix —
never the input stream or a parse trace
writes: 1 the output stream (words via the reverse chain) and 8, the walk's work meter
policy: GeneratePolicy, a separate reconstruction-owned head over the top slot (input
detached) + menu features; cross-entropy to the recorded choice; untrained, it stops
decoding: the declared generate faces; a binary without its witness takes one bounded search
residual: absolute MSE per lane (form, for, against), exact below RMS 1e-4
gradient: live in generate; stops at the concluded idea

one vocabulary of operator identities; a compose face alone grants no thought permission; operators are reconstruction-owned (separateChooser=true keeps the answer's gradient out; per-operator dissonance is a read-only diagnostic) · the CLOSING (not an operator) reads 4 and 6, writes 7 and 6 (the rows and expectation's two-lane residual), and keeps the strictly better trial by R + A
C. Operator signatures — roles × faces × subsystem access
field operations — the typed bracket table; field operands only; one compose softmax (6.8)
bracket actions 0-2; the declaration reads percepts only and writes nothing; no generate face (reverse raises)
bracket actions 3-4, field_reduce over the bracket: and = (min for, max against), or = (max for, min against)
exchange the two lanes; self-inverse; trust is unchanged; compose takes a field operand only (field action 5); thought negates a meaning
leaf readings — interpret is forced at the word transaction; the chooser takes the second reading
mandatory in reading mode (the eager word transaction admits the form, reads its object); a field makes it a chooser option; DEF rows are written at the close
Peirce's index at every interpreted leaf, a known word included; identity on the word; the kept close opens the pointed-at occurrence's MTM token, null kind; was witness (2026-11-01)
the icon (§32.4), reached only with the forcing lifted on the layer instance (certificate v): the leaf keeps its form, and the kept close opens its own occurrence's token holding it, null kind
concept and symbol folds — meaning: the declared rule, else a learned lane kernel on the head; form: the leaf-weighted centroid
clear the for lane; the journal retains the operand as a marked witness; the declared generate rule is unavailable (reverse raises)
Ops: elementwise min, a zero coordinate silent / elementwise max; meaning block: the bilattice rule, for (min / max), against (max / min)
Ops: product binding of unit directions × activations / probabilistic sum a+b−ab; meaning block: the same rules as intersection / union
sum is the mean (meaning rule); product multiplies coordinates (Ops) and is a lane kernel on meaning; chunk is now synthesize, below
select the head's native sigma cases by the modifier (a learned lane-kernel test on meaning); the unary face takes the unfiltered head as object
verb head is I1, subtyped by its object (lane kernel); adverb: a multiplicative group action; the right operand witnesses both inverses
the sentence fold: the VP acts on the NP as a diagonal verb-group action; NP + VP lowers one order, a chosen adverb withholds it
a determiner selects; referent mint / bind / kind (universal: compose only); the marker adds no content; the inverse needs the marker
nominal type marker with reference mode generic; numeric models pass the value; independent of the retired exist carrier
surface absorbs a marker, projecting its right operand (numeric); transpose swaps the newest pair exactly; surface = absorb + transpose only
numeric: the phrase passes; meaning: the marker heads the kernel, the phrase its context; inverse needs the marker; > one position op (2026-10-20)
compose: one action per frame-accessible or trial-local location + a zero-logit dummy; thought: resolve a selected open site; no generate rule
relations and checked thought — permission masks the same exhaustive declaration; only <thought> authorizes execution
compose: numeric passes the whole (part: right, whole: left); thought part leaves the residual x·(y/|y|) and its support; whole = part(argin2, argin1)
symbolic faces: LTM1 relation evidence first, then the taxonomy's bounded path (isPart, 10; open side = neighbours); isEqual reads LTM1 only
compose: mutual parthood (numeric); thought: the conceptual identity score; a kept close writes an LTM1 row; raiseCount relata raise a class
structural carrier on sum; the clause close keeps both operands; thought implies is part's containment; default.grammar: thought face only
fill a row's open references as a subgoal (continuation), else the LTM best match; compose / generate faces are carriers; was what
the bounded LTM read: the best match with content, pair and witnessing occurrence; was lookup
isTrue: an ended row's pair, trust and witnesses by reference (7); exist: conceptual presence as a pair; no scalar truth
one symbolic derivation in two directions over LTM1 and the taxonomy; accepts a pair from evidence, independent of intuit's proposal
the order-0 Sigma-over-Pi DNF over LTM1 rules, in an addressed STM slot; output-owned sparse weights (intuitionCapacity); writes 2
set expectation's gain from the concept's magnitude; replaces arma / expect
perceptual cover — <PartSpace>: Synthesize is compose, Analyze is generate (tier P)
the marker-free structural cover of the PartSpace analyzer; no OperatorEffects declaration, so no cells
complete.grammar only: the residual-bearing additive sum, ex-chunk (catalogue §3.1); no OperatorEffects declaration
retired, registered only, and not operators
raise at load with their replacements: ask or query, query, isTrue, isPart, isEqual
raise at load: synthesize; all concepts are symbolized; sentenceExpectation and gain; symbolize stays future work
neither registered nor declared; > tense, aspect, preposition and modal become one position operation (2026-10-20)
registered layers no shipped grammar declares: coordinate min / max, the null identity, assertPart as an alias of part
not operators: STOP ends a walk; the closing reads 4 and 6, writes the LTM rows and expectation's residual, and keeps the better trial
D. Operators and their inverses — the reverse program that replays a recorded derivation backward
what it needs · what is lost
exact with this occurrence's retained operand (the recorded replay; meaning-block models)
meaning: 2 × parent − witness; form: split the leaf-weighted centroid
the other operand; free decoding searches the primed bank
invert the chart-affine kernel (positive diagonal) given the other operand; split the form centroid
the operand the head role leaves known (lower: the marker); an out-of-cube result is unavailable
the same kernel inverse, given the right operand
numeric models instead: part / whole pass the whole, equal searches, implies is residual
undo the diagonal action by its restricted SPD solve
the right operand: the verb phrase / the adverb
nothing; excluded from the generate menu as a pair rewrite
the derived index's word for the object (a tensor re-activates the word bank)
exactly one word, else a lexical selection; declares no inverse_kind
return the word it was applied to
declares no inverse_kind (reverse_unary_step treats that as unavailable); was witness until 2026-11-01
bounded search, or the occurrence's witness only
recorded replay: none (child undefined, no operand invented); free: a K × K pair search through the same compose face
the primed bank, K = reconstructionBasisLimit (16); lane magnitudes read back after the forms
recorded replay: keep the witness, split the form, meaning undefined; free: search the primed native cases
both poles retained; no occurrence trace or fabricated split
the journal returns the operand it retained
the expressed evidence; no free inverse, never its own inverse
the location operand is an identity: the mention returns as an occurrence witness
no generate rule; thought bind's reverse re-emits the request leaves
recorded replay keeps the value; free generation inverts the meaning lane kernel
query, isTrue, exist, isPart, isEqual, infer, inferBackward, intuit, gain: boundary executors, nothing to replay
exact: parent − witness; PEEL with a basis; the empty split (parent, 0) without one
chunk's residual contract under its new name

every reverse step reports availability, and a missing inverse is explicit: the traversal never substitutes an identity pseudo-inverse · the recorded replay (DerivationReconstruction) inverts only recorded operators and leaves the search folds undefined rather than inventing operands; free generation decodes through GeneratePolicy and one bounded pair search

WITNESS here = the retained constituent of this occurrence, its journal frame (not the sign operator). It is present for reconstruction and absent in free generation — which is why one operator can have two inverses here
Open questions for the pen (numbers kept from 2026-10-03; answered ones dropped): (4) why / how as walks over implies / operator rows — wait for two truths (item 7)?
(5) 7.5 deferred two levers: a nonzero training temperature, and a parsimony / work term against the round budget (a lesson-owned reduction pressure now exists) — take either up?
(6) forgetting of the concept inventory itself — order-0 definitions, alternatives, feature groups — has no rule (item 5 or FutureWork?); DEF rows already share the store's retention

On the inverses (D): (8) the search folds (and compound's case search) are the only operators with no closed form — should compose PREFER an invertible fold where both fit, the way item 8 prefers the structural face at equal fit?
(11) surface's free-generation marker prior survives only in numeric models; on the meaning block free generation searches — retire the prior, or keep it as the guess about the word?
